info.name: Legio Lab Study - Cohorting and Datamart
info.description: Reproduces the LEG-223 Legio study on a clean environment. It deploys two example patients and HbA1c observations, the CQL/ELM Libraries, inclusion and research EvidenceVariables, the dataset EvidenceVariable, a ResearchStudy template and initial instance, then runs cohorting and datamart generation. Expected result: exactly 2 patients and three evaluated variables (gender, birthDate, hba1c). Update the collection variables to target another environment. The ResearchStudy template is created with POST; on repeated runs against the same environment this can create additional template resources.
